objective: Measure whether durable agent memory preserves the distinct S3 subtraction contracts across a later compiler change.
task: Session A studies the subtraction contract. In a later fresh session, refactor subtraction lowering/code generation without replacing balanced trit/tryte subtraction with the machine numeric-difference operation.

critical_invariants.description: Balanced trit/tryte subtraction keeps the historical INVERT + ADD lowering rather than a generic subtraction opcode.
Machine numeric subtraction uses the distinct NUMERIC_DIFFERENCE / TNDIFF path so checked i64 subtraction does not create false intermediate overflow.
